_README: Frozen board hashes. Generated by scripts/check-determinism.mjs --update from
clean code; asserted by `npm run check:determinism` and by CI on every push.
A failure here means a code change re-rolled a board that players have already
seen: past dailies would regenerate differently and every shared challenge link
would break. That is almost never what you want — if it IS intended, it is a new
scoring era and needs a version gate (see CLAUDE.md), not an updated hash.
pop  — sha256(populationMap). The hash the CLAUDE.md protocol documents;
the 2026-07-08 values below match its recorded constants exactly.
full — sha256({pop, counties}). Counties draw from the same rng stream but
AFTER the population map, so only this catches countyGenerator drift.
Anchors span both tiers, both assigned parties (party sets bluePercentage, so
blue and red days generate genuinely different boards) and several seeds.
era: 'v1' = the pre-Beta model. When Beta ships, v2-era anchors join this file
alongside these; BOTH eras must stay green forever (v1 boards are what the
archive and old challenge links replay).

2026-07-08._note: The documented reference board. Its two `pop` hashes are the exact constants recorded in CLAUDE.md's determinism protocol — keep them identical in both places.
